summary: Thimarafushi Airport is a small domestic airport serving Thimarafushi, a populated island in the Thaa Atoll of the Maldives. It functions as a vital regional link, providing inter-island connectivity for local residents and visitors traveling between this atoll and other parts of the country. The facility supports short take-off and landing operations typical of Maldives domestic aviation.
faqs:
Q: What type of airport is Thimarafushi Airport?
A: It is a small domestic airport primarily serving local and regional flights within the Maldives.

Q: Which airlines operate at Thimarafushi Airport?
A: Domestic carriers such as Maldivian operate scheduled inter-island flights connecting Thimarafushi to Malé and other atolls.

Q: Are there international flights at Thimarafushi Airport?
A: No, the airport handles only domestic flights. International travelers must connect through Velana International Airport in Malé.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: As a small regional airport, it offers basic terminal facilities suited for short domestic flights rather than extensive commercial amenities.
transport_tips: The airport is located on Thimarafushi island itself, making access straightforward with a short walk or quick motorbike ride to most guesthouses and the harbor. There is no public bus service; taxis and pre-arranged transfers from local accommodations are the most common options. Ferry services from neighboring atoll islands also connect to Thimarafushi for travelers arriving by sea.
local_tip: Pack light and bring reef-safe sunscreen — many guesthouses arrange boat excursions directly from the island, so you can step off the plane and be snorkeling the same afternoon.
